title: Himachal Congress protests Rahul Gandhi's detention and alleged vote theft in Shimla

tea.why: Protesters opposed the detention of Rahul Gandhi by Delhi Police and alleged "vote theft" by the BJP.
tea.want: Protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the safeguarding of democracy.
tea.changed: Oct 7: Himachal Congress leaders protested in Shimla and submitted a memorandum to the Governor.

summary: The Himachal Pradesh Congress held a protest in Shimla on October 7, 2026, outside Lok Bhavan. Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu, state Congress president Vinay Kumar, and other party officials participated. Protesters opposed the detention of Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi by Delhi Police, which they described as an attack on democracy and the Constitution. They also raised slogans against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, demanding his resignation and alleging "vote theft" by the BJP. Congress leaders later submitted a memorandum to the Governor at Lok Bhavan.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: Himachal Pradesh Congress protested outside Lok Bhavan in Shimla, with Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu and other leaders participating.
